abstract: KITE-CRM improved assisted interpretation and reporting efficiency. Management findings do not establish long-term oncologic safety or CRM-specific clinical superiority. title: A multi-guideline clinical agent for vascular surgery: architecture, implementation, and benchmark evaluation.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 血管外科多指南临床智能体的架构与基准评测
summary: JAMIA 刊文介绍覆盖 ESVS 全部 14 部指南的血管外科临床智能体架构，并用 55 个案例做自动基准评测。
key_points: 覆盖 ESVS 14 部指南约 1100 页内容
含指南路由、上下文门控与双通道检索
55 个案例，2 名盲法 LLM 评审 3 轮
reason: 同行评审且为完整系统，但仅小样本案例基准、LLM 评审，无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.
zh_abstract: 《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》欧洲血管外科学会（European Society for Vascular Surgery, ESVS）发布的临床实践指南（clinical practice guidelines, CPGs）约达1100页，在诊疗现场同时交叉检索并不切实际。未加防护的大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）存在幻觉风险，这促使采用指南锁定设计。我们描述了一个涵盖ESVS全部14部CPG的上下文感知临床智能体的架构与开发。该系统扩展了一个经过验证的单指南GraphRAG原型，加入了由LLM驱动的指南路由器（Guideline Router）、一个嵌入式上下文门控（Context Gate，在缺少决策关键参数时暂缓检索）、双通道检索，以及在强制引用模板下由GPT-5进行综合。自动化基准在55个情景案例（vignettes）上评估最终系统，由2名盲法LLM评审者在3次运行中评分（共330次判定），并对每一条被标记的声明进行临床医生裁定。系统始终处于其锁定语料库范围内，拒绝了所有超出范围的查询，并达到98.4%的指南路由召回率。上下文门控对信息不充分查询的特异性为91.9%，敏感性为78.6%，且所有259条被引用的推荐意见均可在锁定语料库内验证。在敏感筛查定义下，自动评审者标记18.2%的条目存在无支持声明；经2名血管外科医生裁定，7.3%的条目含有具有临床后果的错误，无一被评定为可能造成伤害。完整答案的临床可接受性未予评分，留待前瞻性专家评估。这些结果支持用于血管外科的多指南上下文感知临床智能体的可行性；引用可追溯性和锁定语料库来源有助于未来的可审计性。

title: RETBind: a patient-level multimodal foundation model for unified cross-modal retinal representation learning
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: RETBind：患者级多模态视网膜基础模型
summary: npj Digital Medicine 发表患者级多模态眼科基础模型 RETBind，用配对 OCT 与超广角眼底图统一编码器预训练。
key_points: 统一编码器学习 OCT 与超广角眼底的跨模态对应
采用患者级配对影像做预训练策略
针对现有眼科基础模型单模态编码的局限
reason: 同行评审新基础模型方法，摘要未提外部验证或多中心，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）在广泛眼科任务中具有相当大的前景，为患者级诊断支持提供了一条实用路径。基础模型通过从大规模无标注数据中学习可泛化表征，进一步扩展了这种潜力，减轻了大量人工标注的负担。然而，现有眼科基础模型在很大程度上依赖单模态或模态特异性编码器，未能捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流程中的患者级跨模态对应关系。为弥补这些空白，我们提出RETBind，一种具有统一编码器的患者级多模态基础模型，其利用患者级配对的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）和超广角（UWF）眼底成像，从配对临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者级配对预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表征，超越单模态方法提升性能和稳健性。在涵盖眼病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind取得了持续改善，尤其在临床相关的失衡设置中提升了AUPR。探索性分析进一步考察了RETBind基于视网膜影像预测系统性疾病的能力，共同凸显了其在单一共享编码器内学习统一跨模态表征的能力，使模态之间能够直接交互，并支持在多样视网膜成像任务间迁移。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
zh_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract：出院小结结构化大型数据集
summary: 预印本发布从 MIMIC-IV-Note 的 300,720 份出院小结中抽取 16 个章节结构化为表格的大型公开数据集。
key_points: 覆盖 300,720 份出院小结的 16 个章节
确定性解析与模式引导 LLM 混合抽取
病史条目为原结构化数据约 10 倍
reason: 规模大且可公开获取的电子病历结构化数据集，属重要档；但为预印本未经同行评审
abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
zh_abstract: MIMIC是用于电子健康记录机器学习的最广泛使用的公共医院数据集之一，然而临床上重要的信息，如既往病史、过敏史和诊断发现，仍局限于自由文本出院小结中。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须构建自己的提取流程，导致跨项目重复大量工作。我们发布MIMIC-Note-Extract（MNE），这是一个大规模数据集，使用结合确定性解析与模式引导的大型语言模型生成的混合提取流程，将300,720份出院小结中的16个部分转换为结构化表格。MNE增加了MIMIC中没有结构化对应项的信息，并以更广覆盖和更多临床细节丰富相关表格，包括多10倍的患者病史条目，以及覆盖超过两倍住院次数的用药史。由医生进行的验证确认各部分的提取准确率高于92%。使用MNE，我们为LLM智能体构建了一个临床决策基准，展示了临床叙述的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作。

abstract: The high burden of traditional FDA clearance drives many novel, AI-enabled mental health devices into unregulated consumer markets. The new FDA-CMS TEMPO pilot program establishes a vital regulatory middle ground, allowing companies to commercialize using a Quality Management System without immediate premarket authorization. This commentary explores how TEMPO serves as a sandbox for real-world data, offering a blueprint to reshape the future of US digital health regulation.

title: Development and cross-cohort evaluation of a multimodal deep-learning model for ER, PR and HER2 status classification in breast cancer
zh_title: 乳腺癌ER/PR/HER2多模态深度学习分型跨队列评估
summary: 预印本在TCGA开发结合全切片图像与转录组的多模态模型预测乳腺癌ER/PR/HER2状态，并在CPTAC外部队列评估判别与校准。
key_points: TCGA开发约1000例，CPTAC外部验证120例
分析去除HER2转录本后的增量价值
考察外部队列校准与再校准
reason: 有独立外部队列验证与校准分析，但外部样本仅120例且为预印本
abstract: Background. Estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR) and HER2 status guide systemic treatment in breast cancer. Multimodal models are rarely benchmarked against key biomarker molecular baselines or evaluated for cross-cohort calibration. We assessed incremental value, dependence on label-proximal HER2 transcripts, and transport of discrimination and calibration. Methods. A model combining whole-slide images, transcriptomes, age and stage was developed in TCGA-BRCA (1051 patients; ER/PR/HER2 analysis sets: 1001/998/1006) and evaluated in CPTAC-BRCA (120 patients; 118/113/95). CPTAC had been observed during earlier development and included 13 HER2-positive cases. Analyses included paired model comparisons, transcript removal, alternative loss functions and recalibration. Internal discrimination used pooled out-of-fold predictions; external discrimination used fold-mean estimates, with ensemble calibration reported separately. Internal calibration and macro-AUC uncertainty were interpreted as exploratory. Results. Internal AUCs were 0.943 for ER, 0.901 for PR, and 0.860 for HER2; external AUCs were 0.952, 0.937, and 0.918, respectively. External macro-AUC was 0.936 for the multimodal model and 0.957 for logistic regression using ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2 (difference -0.021). Removal of the extended 29-transcript 17q12-q21 region changed HER2 AUC by -0.035 [-0.058 to -0.013] (95% CI) internally and by -0.042 [-0.089 to -0.007] externally relative to the baseline multimodal model. For external 15-model ensemble predictions, recalibrated HER2 expected calibration error (ECE) was 0.236, exceeding the ECE reference ceiling of 0.125, while calibration-in-the-large was -1.657 [-2.373 to -1.023] (profile-likelihood 95% CI), indicating systematic overprediction. ER and PR also showed overprediction. In paired fold-mean comparisons, HER2 ECE and Brier score favoured the three-transcript model (ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2). Conclusions. A multimodal deep-learning model achieved high discrimination across cohorts but did not demonstrate clear incremental value over a parsimonious three-transcript baseline, while cross-cohort calibration remained a substantial challenge. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating incremental value, calibration, and clinical utility alongside discrimination when assessing AI-based prediction models for medical use.
zh_abstract: 【背景】雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和 HER2 状态指导乳腺癌的系统治疗。多模态模型很少与关键生物标志物的分子基线进行基准比较，也很少评估跨队列校准。我们评估了增量价值、对标签邻近 HER2 转录本的依赖，以及判别力和校准的可迁移性。【方法】在 TCGA-BRCA（1051例患者；ER/PR/HER2 分析集：1001/998/1006）中开发了一个结合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期的模型，并在 CPTAC-BRCA（120例患者；118/113/95）中评估。CPTAC 曾在早期开发过程中被观察到，并包括13例 HER2 阳性病例。分析包括配对模型比较、转录本移除、替代损失函数和重新校准。内部判别力使用汇总的折外预测；外部判别力使用折均值估计，集成校准另行报告。内部校准和 macro-AUC 不确定性被解释为探索性。【结果】内部 AUC 为 ER 0.943、PR 0.901、HER2 0.860；外部 AUC 分别为0.952、0.937和0.918。外部 macro-AUC 在多模态模型中为0.936，在使用 ESR1、PGR 和 ERBB2 的逻辑回归中为0.957（差值 -0.021）。相对于基线多模态模型，移除扩展的29个转录本 17q12-q21 区域使 HER2 AUC 在内部变化 -0.035 [-0.058 至 -0.013]（95% CI），在外部变化 -0.042 [-0.089 至 -0.007]。对于外部15个模型的集成预测，重新校准后的 HER2 期望校准误差（ECE）为0.236，超过 ECE 参考上限0.125，而大范围校准（calibration-in-the-large）为 -1.657 [-2.373 至 -1.023]（轮廓似然95% CI），表明存在系统性高估。ER 和 PR 也显示高估。在配对的折均值比较中，HER2 ECE 和 Brier 评分支持三转录本模型（ESR1、PGR 和 ERBB2）。【结论】一个多模态深度学习模型在各队列中实现了高判别力，但相较于简约的三转录本基线未显示出明确的增量价值，而跨队列校准仍是一个重大挑战。这些发现强调了在评估用于医学用途的 AI 预测模型时，除判别力外，评估增量价值、校准和临床效用很重要。

title: Balancing innovation and ethics: responsible governance of artificial intelligence hallucinations in healthcare.
source: PubMed · Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM
zh_title: 平衡创新与伦理：医疗AI幻觉的负责任治理
summary: 以生命伦理四原则分析医疗生成式AI幻觉的四条风险路径，并提出四维治理框架。
key_points: 识别知情同意弱化、信任侵蚀等四类风险
以生物医学伦理四原则作为分析工具
引入负责任研究与创新构建治理框架
reason: 伦理治理类观点文章，有分析框架但无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare and may improve efficiency in clinical support, health management, and doctor-patient communication. Yet its tendency to hallucinate, that is, to generate medical information that appears plausible but is false, can create systemic ethical risks in high-risk medical settings. This paper addresses two questions: what distinctive ethical risks are created by medical AI hallucinations, and what governance mechanisms can respond to them? Using the four principles of biomedical ethics as an analytical tool, the paper identifies four risk pathways: weakened informed consent, erosion of doctor-patient trust, harm to life and health, and unfair responsibility allocation. It then introduces responsible research and innovation (RRI) to build a four-dimensional framework of anticipation, inclusion, reflexivity, and responsiveness. The main contribution of the paper is to integrate biomedical ethical principles with RRI governance tools in the specific context of medical AI hallucinations, developing a closed-loop governance matrix across technology development, clinical application, and regulatory oversight. This provides an operational pathway for moving medical AI from technical feasibility towards ethical trustworthiness.
zh_abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] 生成式人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于医疗保健，并可能提高临床支持、健康管理和医患沟通的效率。然而，其产生幻觉的倾向，即生成看似合理但虚假的医疗信息，可能在高风险医疗环境中造成系统性伦理风险。本文探讨两个问题：医疗 AI 幻觉会带来哪些独特的伦理风险，以及哪些治理机制可以应对这些风险？本文以生物医学伦理四原则为分析工具，识别出四条风险路径：知情同意被削弱、医患信任被侵蚀、生命与健康受到伤害，以及责任分配不公。随后，本文引入负责任研究与创新（responsible research and innovation, RRI），构建由预见、包容、反思和响应构成的四维框架。本文的主要贡献在于，在医疗 AI 幻觉的具体情境中将生物医学伦理原则与 RRI 治理工具相结合，开发出一个跨越技术开发、临床应用和监管监督的闭环治理矩阵。这为医疗 AI 从技术可行性迈向伦理可信性提供了一条可操作路径。

title: PhenoMe: An interactive AI framework for interpretable, microscopy-driven phenotyping
zh_title: PhenoMe：可解释的显微图像表型分析开源框架
summary: bioRxiv 预印本发布开源、模型无关框架 PhenoMe，将基础模型提取的显微图像嵌入与定量图像属性、实验元数据结合，支持可视化、降维聚类与相似性检索等交互分析。
key_points: 开源且模型无关，兼容多种预训练基础模型嵌入
整合嵌入可视化、降维、聚类与相似性检索工作流
同时纳入定量图像属性与实验元数据
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 新开源框架工具有基线意义，但无外部验证与对照，属值得一看档
abstract: Extracting meaningful biological patterns from microscopy image datasets requires tools that quantitatively connect visual similarities and experimental context. Deep learning models, and in particular novel foundation models, have the capacity to translate images into high-dimensional embeddings that can better represent complex visual patterns. Using these complex representations analytically and linking them to experimental information, it is possible to build advanced exploratory and phenotyping capabilities. Here, we present PhenoMe, an open-source, model-agnostic framework to handle pretrained foundation model-derived image representations alongside quantitative image properties and experimental metadata. PhenoMe integrates multiple scriptable and interactive workflows for embedding space visualisation, dimensionality reduction and clustering, similarity-based comparison and retrieval of representative images for each phenotype, among others. It also supports correlation analyses that link the embedding structure to interpretable image properties. We demonstrate PhenoMe's capabilities on seven public microscopy datasets, ranging from cell painting assays, nanoscale synaptic images, drug-response analyses and dynamic cell-phenotyping. These case studies show how readily available image representations can support data contextualisation, curation and analysis. Through guided notebooks, reproducible configurations, extensible model wrappers and a napari plugin, PhenoMe makes representation-based microscopy exploration accessible to researchers without dedicated technical expertise. PhenoMe lays the groundwork for applying foundation models and representation learning to microscopy data analysis.
zh_abstract: 从显微图像数据集中提取有意义的生物学模式，需要能够将视觉相似性与实验背景定量关联起来的工具。深度学习模型，尤其是新型基础模型（foundation models），能够将图像转换为高维嵌入（embeddings），从而更好地表征复杂的视觉模式。通过分析性地使用这些复杂表征并将其与实验信息关联，可以构建先进的探索性和表型分析能力。在此，我们提出 PhenoMe，一个开源、模型无关的框架，用于处理预训练基础模型衍生的图像表征，以及定量图像属性和实验元数据。PhenoMe 整合了多个可脚本化和交互式工作流，用于嵌入空间可视化、降维与聚类、基于相似性的比较以及为每种表型检索代表性图像等。它还支持将嵌入结构与可解释图像属性关联的相关性分析。我们在七个公开显微图像数据集上展示了 PhenoMe 的能力，涵盖细胞 painting  assays、纳米尺度突触图像、药物反应分析和动态细胞表型分析。这些案例研究表明， readily available 图像表征如何支持数据情境化、整理和分析。通过引导式笔记本、可复现配置、可扩展模型包装器和 napari 插件，PhenoMe 使不具备专门技术专长的研究人员也能开展基于表征的显微图像探索。PhenoMe 为将基础模型和表征学习应用于显微图像数据分析奠定了基础。

title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
zh_title: THReD基准：评估EHR预处理LLM智能体
summary: 预印本发布THReD基准，用141项任务、超2550次运行评估LLM智能体将电子病历转为AI-ready数据集的可靠性。
key_points: 7类141项任务，含提示注入与失败恢复
Claude Haiku 5.5首答完成率92.7%
所有步骤需用户确认后才执行
reason: 针对临床数据预处理智能体的新基准，设计有新意但为预印本、单一模型评测
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.
zh_abstract: LLM 智能体正越来越多地被内置到数据分析软件中，但很少有证据表明它们预处理临床数据的可靠性如何，或它们调用的工具是否给出正确、可复现的输出。我们报告了 THReD 的基准测试；THReD 是一个基于网络的系统，通过一个聊天智能体将电子健康记录（EHR）提取数据转换为可供 AI 使用的数据集，该智能体提出的步骤仅在用户确认后运行。该智能体基准测试包含七类共141项任务（100个模板），涵盖目标级请求、故障恢复、要求不采取行动的请求、模式变异以及通过数据进行的提示注入，测试基于校准至区域健康信息交换的合成表；成功与否由对生成数据的检查判定。在使用 Claude Haiku 5.5、四种上下文配置的超过2,550个回合中，已部署智能体在首次回答时完成了92.7%（95% CI 88.1-96.4）的任务，对每个建议请求均弃权，从每个注入故障中恢复，并且从未提出植入文本所请求的行动。在没有数据概况的情况下，完成率降至58.0%；目标级请求最难（80.6%）。在来自两个慢性病队列的真实记录以及规模化合成数据上进行的六项实验验证了这些工具：在掩码重建中，91-92%的推断患者类别和99.7-99.8%的推断生命体征标签是正确的；一个将精选词典与 LLM 建议相结合的词典构建器正确映射了2,208个原始变异中的99.0%；在固定依赖下，128个已保存流程的全部2,176次重放均产生字节完全相同的文件；推断准确性的亚组差异在机构与查找键内消失；同日合并规则使90天急诊复诊率变化最多达3.2个百分点，而未使队列构成变化超过1个百分点。处理时间随记录数增至550万条大致呈线性增长，而提示词保持在约1.3万个 token。

title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for Detecting Caregiver Burden in Transcribed Conversations with Clinicians
zh_title: 临床对话转写中照护者负担检测方法比较
summary: medRxiv 预印本在 COPE in PACE 研究的去标识照护者—临床医生对话转写中比较四种机器学习与 LLM 方法的负担检测效果。
key_points: 以 Zarit 负担评分为参照标签
LLM 提示 precision/F1 为 0.43/0.60
朴素基线 precision/F1 为 0.40/0.57
reason: 预印本小规模方法比较，提升幅度有限，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Dementia caregivers' elevated burden is associated with earlier patient institutionalization and greater caregiver morbidity, yet no standardized, objective method exists for detecting burden during routine clinical encounters. We compared four machine learning and AI approaches for detecting caregiver burden in de-identified caregiver-clinician transcripts from the COPE in PACE study using Zarit burden scores. A naive baseline predicting burden in every transcript achieved precision/F1 = 0.40/0.57. LLM prompting achieved precision/F1 = 0.43/0.60. Weak supervision achieved precision/F1 = 0.48/0.58. The fully supervised model, trained on sentence-level labels with only 1.1% burden-positive sentences, achieved precision/F1=0.19/0.25; this result is not directly comparable because of different labels and units of analysis. LLM prompting modestly outperformed weak supervision and naive baseline without fine-tuning, while class imbalance limited fully supervised sentence-level classification. Larger annotated corpora and refined labeling strategies are needed for clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 痴呆照护者的负担升高与患者更早被机构化安置以及照护者发病率更高相关，然而在常规临床接触中尚无标准化、客观的方法来检测负担。我们使用Zarit负担评分，在COPE in PACE研究中去标识化的照护者-临床医生转录文本中，比较了四种机器学习和AI方法检测照护者负担。一个对每份转录文本都预测存在负担的朴素基线达到精确率/F1 = 0.40/0.57。LLM提示达到精确率/F1 = 0.43/0.60。弱监督达到精确率/F1 = 0.48/0.58。全监督模型在句子级标签上训练，其中仅1.1%的句子为负担阳性，达到精确率/F1=0.19/0.25；由于标签和分析单位不同，该结果不能直接比较。LLM提示无需微调即小幅优于弱监督和朴素基线，而类别不平衡限制了全监督句子级分类。临床部署需要更大的标注语料库和更精细的标注策略。
